source: sync03 (2026-11-20): card pushed into / pulled out of the beam, cube removed; latency.py --event
note: Relative to the ultrasonic stream (arrival times). The ultrasonic itself samples every ~100 ms, so a physical event shows up 0-100 ms later in it; that part is random per reading and cannot be removed with a constant offset. An earlier test pushing the cube by hand (sync02) gave 86-148 ms with very flat correlation peaks and inconsistent onsets: slow ramps and long plateaus do not pin down timing.
